description.description: Optional longer description of the habit.

frequency.description: How often the habit is expected to be performed.

targetCount.description: Number of times the habit should be performed within the frequency period.

startDate.description: Date when the habit tracking begins.

endDate.description: Optional date when the habit tracking ends.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the habit was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the habit.

habitId.description: Reference to the associated HabitDefinition id.

date.description: The calendar day this record pertains to.

count.description: How many times the habit was performed on this day.

notes.description: Optional free‑form notes about the day's progress.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last modification to the record.
